about.title: 26 Years of Clear Vision
about.description: Since 1998, Loyal City Optics has been Kuwait's trusted destination for premium eyewear. Located in the heart of Salmiya, we combine expert optical care with the finest international frame collections.
about.story_body:
Founded in 1998 in Salmiya, Kuwait, Loyal City Optics began with a simple mission: to provide every customer with the perfect vision and the perfect frame to match their personality.

Over 26 years, we have served thousands of families across Kuwait, becoming one of the most trusted names in optical care in the country.
